title: Selective Masking based Self-Supervised Learning for Image Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Iterative masked reconstruction that masks the patches with highest reconstruction loss instead of random patches; helps the weakest classes most.
adaptation: Apply to the FCMAE or ridge-target arm: mask hardest-to-reconstruct EL patches (cracks, splices, gridline breaks, edges); targets weak classes gridline, splice, edge_dark as well as crack.
min_experiment: Winner arm with selective vs random masking; kill if out-of-fold relF1@2 < +0.005 and gridline/splice fold IoU < +0.02.
evidence: R: +2.9% (VOC, Cityscapes) and +2.5% (2 weed sets) over random masking and ImageNet; largest gains on lowest classes.
prior_overlap: none: our MIM used random masking.
